long_description.title: A Double Cutaway Classic In Rainbow Leopard
long_description.body: This Leopard is on the prowl and is ready for some shredding. Designed by Kramer Custom Graphic Artist Chris Stemmer and influenced by classic Kramer Leopard graphics, this bright take will make you stand out over other cats for sure! The Baretta Vintage is a tribute to one of the most iconic and original guitar designs in rock. Features an alder body, satin-finished maple neck, a single Seymour Duncan® JB™ zebra-coil humbucker, and a Floyd Rose® 1000 series tremolo with an R2 1000 series locking nut. It is finished in an eye-catching Rainbow Leopard. A premium gig bag is also included.

Neck Specs.Nut Material: Floyd Rose R2 1000 Series Locking Nut with Black String Retaining Bar

Electronics Specs.Bridge Pickup: Seymour Duncan JB Zebra Coil Humbucker
Electronics Specs.Controls: 500K Master Volume with Push/Pull Series/Parallel Switch

Misc Specs.Accessories: Black Wrench Holder - Back of Headstock
